groups.defect: In parseRefreshTokenResponse, both computed keys in minimumTokenResponseSchema turn into the same literal property name, so they are not wildcards. In sync mode zod therefore strips the expiry fields and any real refresh_token. On top of that, the function always fills in the placeholder "refresh_token", which overwrites real stored tokens.

answer.reasoning:
s_225f2832 and s_e2658a12 point at the same lines in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts and report the same two problems. First, the computed keys collapse to one property, so the expiry and refresh_token fields get stripped. Second, the code always injects the placeholder "refresh_token". s_e2658a12 adds caller-specific effects (Zoom gets NaN for the expiry; Office365 overwrites the real stored refresh token), so the merged comment should be unified.

s_52923eef reports defects specific to the Salesforce code: it refreshes the token unconditionally every time, it checks statusText instead of response.ok, and it builds the jsforce Connection with the stale access token. It only mentions the placeholder logic in passing, as one consequence in its explanation. Its fix does not touch that logic, and its main defects need separate edits in the Salesforce file. So it does not share a reported defect with the parser suggestions and stays separate. Judge 1 read that passing mention as a real overlap, which is a reasonable reading, so this is a judgment call.
